_doc: Single-k sweep: E(k) at ONE k = s(1,1,1) (kmesh 1x1x1, so k = kShift exactly; was `gpwprobe ksweep`, GPW_KSHIFT=s).  s=0 (Gamma) and s=1/2 (L) are TRIM (real blocks);
strictly between is genuinely complex and exercised by nothing else.  E(k) is smooth in k: a KINK on entering the complex region localises a defect to one k-block's operators.
for s in 0 0.125 0.25 0.375 0.5; do rundeck decks/probes/Si_single_k.json --set solid.kShift=[$s,$s,$s] --out $(scripts/rundir qchem6 Si); done
